```
['create a RealSenseCamera instance with custom width, height, and fps parameters', 'call get_frame on a RealSenseCamera to retrieve synchronized RGB and depth numpy arrays', 'call release on a RealSenseCamera to stop the pipeline and free camera resources', 'run the test function to preview live color and depth frames from a RealSense camera', 'run the module directly to start a RealSense camera preview loop with color and depth visualization', 'create a WebcamCamera instance to capture frames from a USB webcam device', 'call get_frame on a WebcamCamera to retrieve the current RGB frame as a dictionary', 'call release on a WebcamCamera to free the underlying OpenCV VideoCapture resource', 'run the test function to display live webcam frames in an OpenCV window', 'review the WebcamCamera class to understand its frame capture and resource management API']
```

```
{'create_realsense_camera': 'create a RealSenseCamera instance with custom width, height, and fps parameters', 'get_frame_rgb_depth': 'call get_frame on a RealSenseCamera to retrieve synchronized RGB and depth numpy arrays', 'release_camera_resources': 'call release on a RealSenseCamera to stop the pipeline and free camera resources', 'test_realsense_streaming': 'run the test function to preview live color and depth frames from a RealSense camera', 'run_realsense_main': 'run the module directly to start a RealSense camera preview loop with color and depth visualization'}
```
